title: SVG and Icon Components knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying SVG and Icon Components?
options: use styles that reflect actual component state and preserve usable focus indicators
It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
questions.answer_key: use styles that reflect actual component state and preserve usable focus indicators
questions.explanation: SVG and Icon Components is best understood through the syllabus topics: Inline SVG styling, Fill and stroke utilities, Icon sizing and alignment. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with svg and icon components?
options: Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
test keyboard focus, disabled/selected states and reduced-motion preferences where relevant
questions.answer_key: test keyboard focus, disabled/selected states and reduced-motion preferences where relevant
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Inline SVG styling, Fill and stroke utilities, Icon sizing and alignment, Icon and text combinations.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying svg and icon components?
options: Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
hover-only styling does not replace keyboard feedback or actual functionality
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
questions.answer_key: hover-only styling does not replace keyboard feedback or actual functionality
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
